2.33.72: The overview over a fullscreen game no longer rebuilds the Island and Dock on every press: they keep their layer, on Umbriel and Niri
2.33.71: Widgets joined to the frame are now the frame itself: one body with its matter, texture and edge, above your windows like the bubbles, and still there in the overview
With a Design on, the resting Island is yours again: Island › Design and modes › The Design's face
2.33.70: Widgets joined to the frame can rest tucked as a tab until you point at them (Settings › Surfaces › Frame, or per widget), stay on the frame in the overview, join their neighbours cleanly and keep calm under every texture
Prism Settings: the sidebar's sections read brighter
2.33.69: Prism: every panel's black takes a soft haze of the spectrum from one corner, and each place can wear Prism on its own (Settings › Colour › Look › Places)
2.33.68: A desktop widget left against the frame joins it as one body, and lets go when you pull it away (Settings › Surfaces › Frame)
A fifth look, Prism: black and white controls with the spectrum at each level
2.33.67: Hub: a plugin that changes a file of yours, like Fastfetch, gets a switch that turns it off and gives yours back
2.33.66: Settings follow the compositor you run: Niri shows what Niri does, Umbriel gets pages of its own
Umbriel: layouts drawn as pictures, tabs, title bars, glass, effects you press on a drawn desktop, hot corners, HDR and colour depth
Display: drag your screens to where they stand, pick a scale from miniatures of your own screen, and keep or undo a change within 15 seconds
Prism Settings: the side column folds by itself on pages that need the width, with a button to open or close it
Prism Settings: the open page is named in your accent on a quiet plate of it, so where you are reads at a glance
A Design can bring the faces of your desktop widgets while it is on (Prism does); taking it off gives yours back
2.33.65: Runs on NixOS: every tool and app is found on your PATH, not only in /usr/bin
2.33.60: Prism Settings: rows that pick several pieces show which are on and in what order; a tap adds to the list instead of replacing it
React with any emoji: one small pill opens a search, and votes and reactions show the moment people give them
2.33.59: Bubbles stacked in a corner or along its edge join as one smooth body, without a bulge each
Vote and react on any hub item, and see how many people have it
Prism Settings: search answers as you type, values save once per wheel turn, and scrolling stays smooth
2.33.58: The frame can grow a rail on the left or right, and the dock lives inside it
Bubbles join a line where you drop them and keep their order
A larger player: cover, title and five controls on discs, 10 s steps
The song length no longer jumps between tracks; shuffle and repeat on both players
Vitals as a chart and four tiles
Hub items say what is new in their version; inir hub open lands on the Hub

summary: One living body: the Island, the chassis and Apple-grade motion.
